dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Want a letter mailed? It's good to keep in touch with your family and friends, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you do overseas delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Theoretically speaking, it shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: It'll be a bit difficult for me to leave Natlan personally, though. I'll have to submit multiple rounds of applications to the Wayob, and even then, it's anyone's guess whether or not my leave permit will be granted...

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Haha, jokes aside.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: If letters need to be sent abroad, we'll usually take them to the border, before handing them over to our colleagues from the other nations.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Anyway, just leave it to me! I promise you that I'll get it delivered!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wonder how you'd send a letter to someone without an address.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Haha, so it's not so much a letter as a missing person poster, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: If you're looking for someone, you might want to try your luck with the People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Their folks and Saurians are all super knowledgeable. They are adept at both pathfinding and navigation.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Some people have said that Koholasaurs are like dogs that live in water, and I think they're on to something.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Their only flaw is that they tend to work rather... slowly. You might have to wait a while before you can be reunited again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine for now.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: No worries! Just come find me if you need a letter delivered.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to love your job.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Of course!

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: You can stay in shape, enjoy the scenery, and even enjoy the happy smiles on the recipients' faces when they get the letter at long last. There's no other job that'll let you have all that!

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: It's true that I'll have to be the harbinger of bad news every once in a while, but the longer you work this job, the more you learn that good things still outweigh bad things in this world!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you do overseas delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Of course! If I ever want to leave Natlan, I just need to submit a request to the chief. I never have to wait long for approval.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: That said, I do most of my deliveries within our borders.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: If letters need to be sent abroad, we'll usually take them to the border, before handing them over to our colleagues from the other nations.

dialogues.speaker: Tundama
dialogues.text: Anyway, just leave it to me! I'll get it delivered — that's a promise!
